content: OpenHands architecture: append-only typed event stream as single source of truth (MessageEvent/ActionEvent/ObservationEvent/AgentError/Condensation); replaying the log reconstructs the conversation. V0 had AgentController (supervisor enforcing iteration and budget limits, lifecycle start/stop/pause) + Runtime abstraction (sandboxed execution); V1 collapsed controller+runtime into Conversation + Workspace, reporting 61% fewer system-attributable failures, and noting event-sourcing overhead is negligible. Key transferable lessons: budget/iteration caps belong in the supervisor not the agent; the execution environment is a swappable Workspace abstraction; event-sourced history is cheap and worth it.
